wip-artifact: Viable Artifact Set with WIP Calculations:
tips-bol: Bond of Life is a mechanic that **absorbs any healing** a character receives. It appears as a **red outline around their HP bar**, and its maximum value is 200% of the character's HP (represented by an outline around the entire HP bar). To clear a Bond of Life, the character must **receive healing equal to its value**.
tips-ssw: When Stellar Swirl is triggered, a Stellar Vortex is created. These vortexes explode after a short time. The **more times Stellar Swirl is triggered**, the **higher the explosion DMG** of the vortex.
4vv-p45: Anemo characters can be extremely good at buffing **Pyro/Electro/Cryo/Hydro** with this artifact set. It is recommended to spend minimal resin to give your anemo support a cheap 4pc set (regardless of the stats) if it helps your team.
4scroll-p45: Natlan supports can easily buff elements reacting with their own with this artifact set. Getting a cheap 4pc set regardless of stats would be beneficial if it helps your team.
4dm-p45: It is recommended to use this set on someone on your team for teams that do mainly Dendro DMG. Similar to **Viridescent Venerer (4)** for Anemo characters, it is recommended to spend minimal resin to give your support a cheap 4pc set (regardless of the stats) if your team falls into this category. Anyone on the team can use the set (provided they can trigger the 4pc effect), including non-dendro characters.
